options.reason: The table was assembled to relate TCGA gene expression to PAM50 subtype: one row per tumour sample, ~17.8k log2 expression features, and PAM50 as the single five-level outcome, so multiclass prediction. sample_id is a pure row key. No repeated subject, batch or device column and no chronological ordering, so no grouping or time constraints. The CPTAC cohort is a hold-out transfer test, not a training table; models are selected on TCGA by macro-F1 with per-class precision-recall and confusion matrix.
options.title: multiclass
